title: Traveler's Manuscript
text: This manuscript is hidden in the loot crystal ball left when the Golden Throne in the Frozen Terra Palace crumbles.
Read it page by page to discover what the traveler encountered.
Finish the final page with an empty talent slot to gain Psyker and a random blessing of Khorne, Tzeentch, Nurgle or Slaanesh. Existing talents and curses are not overwritten; the manuscript remains.
Psyker grants 20% more mana regeneration and spell power, plus 10% cooldown reduction.
Khorne increases damage dealt by 20% and damage taken by 50%. Tzeentch gives each cast a 20% chance to cost half your current health and add 100% spell power to that cast.

Nurgle maintains Regeneration I and has a 20% chance to summon a zombie variant nearby when hurt. Slaanesh encourages nearby adult animals to breed; taking damage causes three seconds of Pleasurable Agony, preventing movement and reflecting damage to the attacker.
Talents and curses cannot be removed by hand. The cleansing ritual removes them together.
The Star of Fulfillment removes only the curse. The retained talent still prevents obtaining another talent.
